items.title: Fixing One Function's Disk Spills with ALTER FUNCTION … SET work_mem
items.blurb: Use PostgreSQL ALTER FUNCTION SET work_mem to stop one function's sorts spilling to disk without a global change. A production fix: 150 GB a day to 0.

items.title: When to Choose x86 or ARM for Postgres
items.blurb: ARM and x86 can give you different performance at the same vCPU count. Here's what differs, what to measure, and how to choose.

items.title: Kafgres 0.2: 700 MB/s of Kafka Throughput on Postgres
items.blurb: Profiling and optimizing the Kafgres Postgres extension to achieve 700 MB/s write throughput and 600k evt/s on a single machine.

items.title: pgBackRest and Failover: Why archive_mode Matters
items.blurb: A recent question on the community channels described a difficult situation: a standby had been promoted with archive_mode=off, and restarting the new primary was something the team wanted to avoid.
